title: Alarm
prompt: Write `blink`, which prints "blink". Then write `alarm`, which calls blink three times and then prints "alarm". `run` calls alarm once; the output is blink, blink, blink, alarm.
hints: A helper can both call other helpers and print on its own.
alarm has four lines: three `blink()` calls and one print.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
